settings.description: The most projects a person may have, archived ones included, from 1 to 10000.
The most characters a project's name may have, from 1 to 500.
The most characters a project's instructions may have, from 0 to 200000. The instructions go into every call of every chat in the project, at the start, so a provider can cache them.
The most knowledge files one project may have, from 0 to 500.
The largest knowledge file a project takes, in bytes. A larger one is refused. Until uploads give a route a body limit of its own, server.max_body_bytes bounds it too.

The endings of the files a project takes as knowledge files, separated by commas. A file must be UTF-8 text with no zero bytes. Its text is read once, when it is added, and goes into every call of the project's chats.

The most characters of one knowledge file's text that go into a call, from 100 to 1000000. The rest is left out, with a note. All attachments together take no more than chats.context_attached_percent of a call.

settings.default: This chat is in the person's project "{name}". The person wrote these instructions for every chat in it:
settings.description: The line before a project's instructions, at the start of every call of a chat in it. {name} becomes the project's name. Nothing is sent when the project has no instructions.

settings.default: A knowledge file of the person's project "{project}": {name}. Its text:
settings.description: The line before a knowledge file's text, with the attachments of every call of a chat in the project. {project} becomes the project's name and {name} the file's.

settings.default: [The rest of {name}, {chars} more characters, is left out.]
settings.description: The line after a knowledge file's text that was cut to projects.file_context_max_chars. {name} becomes the file's name and {chars} the number of characters left out.

The knowledge store space a new project's chats keep their facts in, as the memory pass writes them. {slug} becomes the project's name in lower case, with a hyphen for each run of other characters. Empty keeps a new project's facts in knowledge.memory_space with the rest. Each project keeps the space it was given, and a held chat's facts go to knowledge.memory_sensitive_space or nowhere, whatever its project.
Whether recall in a project chat searches the project's memory space first, and gives what it finds there before what it finds elsewhere.
